sdaa_simulation_runs.description: Short validation runs on SDAA device to verify code execution. Full convergence requires 60000+ steps per grid; time constraints limited runs to 4000-5000 steps.

grid_m8_u015.note: Flow developing; X1/H increasing toward reference 6.10 but not yet steady

grid_m12_u012.note: Flow developing; X1/H increasing toward reference 6.10 but not yet steady

grid_m16_u006.note: Flow developing; low u_in means very long convergence time

reference.source: Gartling 1990 IJNMF 11(7):953-967; corroborated by ECN/TNO ECN-E-11-042 and arXiv:2507.16509
reference.re_definition: Re = u_mean * H_channel / nu = 800 (based on downstream channel height H, NOT step height)
reference.geometry: ER=2, step height h=H/2, inlet=upper half channel, fully developed parabolic profile
reference.corroboration: Gartling 12.20, Gresho et al. 12.20, Keskar&Lyn 12.19, Grigoriev&Dargush 12.18 (all in step-height units)

preexisting_comprehensive_results.source: result.json in benchmark directory (Armaly 1983 Re=100 benchmark, separate from Gartling Re=800)
preexisting_comprehensive_results.note: The result.json documents the Armaly/Erturk Re=100 BFS benchmark (ER=1.9423). The run.py implements the Gartling 1990 Re=800 BFS (ER=2). These are two distinct benchmarks in the same directory.
preexisting_comprehensive_results.armaly_re100_verdict: NOT PASSED at Re=100 under pre-registered criterion (best tau-matched level -4.33% vs primary reference Erturk 2.878, needs <=3%)

verdict: HONEST_FAIL — SDAA device verified functional; short runs demonstrate code execution but insufficient steps for convergence; pre-existing comprehensive results (Armaly Re=100) show best tau-matched level at -4.33% > 3% threshold; Gartling Re=800 benchmark requires longer SDAA runs for full evaluation
